lead_post.text:
China outbound used to mean selling products overseas.

The next stage is harder:
buying channels,
buying logistics,
buying local retail assets,
and buying regulatory exposure at the same time.

https://t.co/PHvM7nZdBw’s Ceconomy deal is a good example.

Globalization is no longer just go-to-market. It is governance design.
lead_post.clean_text:
China outbound used to mean selling products overseas.

The next stage is harder:
buying channels,
buying logistics,
buying local retail assets,
and buying regulatory exposure at the same time.

JD.com Ceconomy deal is a good example.

Globalization is no longer just go-to-market. It is governance design.
lead_post.translation_zh:
中国企业出海过去意味着把产品卖到海外。

下一阶段更难：
购买渠道，
购买物流，
购买本地零售资产，
同时也购买监管风险敞口。

JD.com 收购 Ceconomy 的交易就是一个很好的例子。

全球化不再只是进入市场。它是治理设计。
